descriptions.zh: 菲沃尔人给我们留下了一份可怕的赠别礼物：初步遥测显示，他们的巨型质量驱动器最后一次发射瞄准的目标是[Target.GetName]。
descriptions.en: The Fevorians have left us with a dreadful parting gift: initial telemetry has revealed that the final shot of their titanic mass driver was aimed at [Target.GetName].

titles.zh: 黑暗之怖环境改造局势
titles.en: Fear of the Dark Terraforming Situation

descriptions.zh: 进入下一环境改造阶段的进度。
我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]正在从[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]研究对象收集洞见。我们可能会在突破性事件中发现一个新的洞见科技。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] are in the process of gathering Insights from our [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] study subjects. We may discover a new Insight Technology during a breakthrough event.

descriptions.zh: 一种全新的人畜共患疾病已经出现在[Target.GetName]上。由于没有天生的免疫力，也没有对抗感染所需的医疗技术，大量人群正迅速染病受苦，并导致死亡。
descriptions.en: A novel zoonotic disease has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Without natural immunity or the medical technology required to combat the infection, the population is quickly succumbing to misery and death.

descriptions.zh: [Target.GetName]上的人们偶然发现了一个新型的物种。这是一种具有处理复杂行动的能力的节点意识，与这种生物的开展互动最终可能会导致有机奇点的出现。
descriptions.en: The people on [Target.GetName] have stumbled across a new type of species. A nodal consciousness with the ability to handle complex operations, interacting with this creature may eventually result in the advent of an Organic Singularity.

descriptions.zh: 在[Target.GetName]上出现了一位魅力非凡的领袖，宣扬激进的行星统一主义。现在，只有一小群装备相对落后的叛军在反对多数派统治。
descriptions.en: Preaching a radical doctrine of planetary unification, a charismatic leader has appeared on [Target.GetName]. Now, only a small and relatively ill-equipped band of rebels stands opposed to majoritarian rule.
